ratings.comment: Dr. J is a great lecturer. She always brought good energy to lecture, explained things well, posted all the slides after class and answered questions. For Math 222 in general, it was harder to prepare for the exams this semester because the curriculum was recently adjusted so Midterm 2 and the final were a little different from previous years.
Has online lectures that can be downloaded and used for annotations. Great teacher in lecture and office hours. Amazing at answering questions.

Dr. J was a good professor and explained lectures in a way that made sense to me. However, the practice in lecture was 10x easier than what was on the exam, which is frustrating. I also highly advise against taking this class if you have more than a semester between taking Calc I and don't take with physics 207, as they have exams back to back.

Lectures contain lots of practice, which is helpful. She will stop and make sure questions are answered before going onto the next slide. You can tell she loves what she's doing which makes the content all the more engaging.
Good professor and easy to understand lectures. Beware that the three exams are worth 87 percent of your grade. But if you go to lectures and watch yt videos you should be okay
Incredibly friendly and cares about the students
Excellent lectures. Plenty of clear explanations and examples. All the slides from the lecture are posted in canvas.
She keeps calc lectures somewhat fun and engaged.

Dr. J was a great professor. She very relatable and she made the lectures engaging. Dr. J made a great effort to get to know the names of all the students in the class. I thought she did a great job at explaining concepts, except for a few occasions where some important topics were kind of glazed over.

Dr. J is one of the best Math teachers/professors I have had. She does a great job during lecture's explaining concepts and making sure you understand the topics. The class itself is hard in nature, but she does a great job explaining each topic.

Dr. J is great.  She made the lectures entertaining and interactive.  She is also always willing to answer questions.  The only problem is your grade is basically 3 test, but there is nothing she can do about that.

Took this class in Fall 2024, it was my first class as a freshman. Dr. J made it very easy to do good in this class because of the great lectures. I would recommend that you go to every lecture because it is very easy to fall behind in Math 222. However, I never skipped a class, attended discussion, and took notes and I ended the class with a 99%.

Dr. J was super sweet, and you could tell that she values making personal connections with her students! One frustrating aspect of the class is that we had three exams, each worth 29%...  if you have one bad exam, it is pretty difficult to work yourself back up (this is standard for all calc professors:( )

Dr. J is a very good professor (and mathematician, I don't know). Her lectures are lively and fun, she likes to describe herself in the third person, and she likes to make little jokes.
Math is boring and difficult for most people, but Dr. J really tries to make the points understandable and accessible to more people!

Dr. J is amazing. She is super friendly and will try to learn everyone's names in lectures. Her slides are organized and she teaches very clearly. Expectations are laid are well. There was even a slight curve at the end of the class which was nice. Do lots of practice problems and you will succeed! Highly recommend her!!!
She cares about her students, but the entire grade is basically based off of 2 midterms and 1 final exam.  Exams were hard, and concepts are only covered once in lecture with no review.

Dr. J is the first person to ever make me not dread going to a math class. She is an incredible professor who cares a lot about her students, even getting to know most students' names. She makes lecture a safe place to ask questions, interesting, and dare I say fun. I would straight up defend her with my life, she's changed my whole mindset on math

Sets up concepts well so class has a good flow and really seems to care about students! Gives great resources for exams so it's not hard to succeed, but discussions can be pretty unhelpful depending on your TA. Grade is mostly based on 2 midterms and the final, so might not be a good fit if you struggle with test taking.

Dr. J is my favorite professor I've had so far! She's very funny and obviously cares about the material. Her teaching was very clear in lectures and she was very helpful during in class exercises. Take her class!!!!

I was not very talented in Math in high school but Dr. J lectures make me become interested in this major and I have become smarter than before. I can also feel her constant kindness and patience. Highly recommend her!

She's the best lecturer I've ever had. She made an effort to get to know her students and made sure to help. She was very organized and explained concepts thoroughly and often makes jokes during lecture.

The best math lecturer! Her lecture notes were nicely organized. She was very clear about the content we needed to know for exams. She explained concepts very thoroughly and made them easy to understand. She was also a very sweet person. She made an effort to get to know her students. I would recommend her to everyone!

THE GOAT. She is the best lecturer I have ever had. She is an amazing person herself. Her lecture notes are amazingly set up. Her way of explaining things is wonderful. I do not have enough room on here to explain how amazing she was. She actually got to know her students by namel. All the other math professors need to learn how to teach from her.
